subject: OBJECT paragraph
notes: GR1: "The IMPLEMENTS clause specifies the names of the interfaces that are implemented by the object of the containing class according to 9.3.11" (cite.py --check 11.8.4 OK; 9.3.11 --check OK). Captured into OoClassSymbol.Implements (instance roster only; the FACTORY list is separate, FactoryImplements), emitted as the C# base list, and checked per §9.3.11 in ValidateImplements.
